questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully visible (e.g., around 00:08), there are exactly three pen-like objects arranged in a row.
All three objects are oriented vertically with the writing end/cap end pointing downwards.
The middle pen appears different; it lacks the thick black cap seen on the left and right pens, looking instead like a bare ink tube or refill.
The middle pen is uncapped or is just a refill, showing a thin dark tip/tube at the bottom, whereas the other two pens have distinct black caps.
The board moves continuously from left to right without stopping or reversing.
The pens remain fixed in their positions relative to the board throughout the movement.

parsed.reason: The middle pen is uncapped (or is a bare refill) while the left and right pens have black caps, violating the condition that all pens must be identical and capped.

description: One pen is missing its cap (variant).
